name: wait_change
title: Wait for Visual Change
description: Read-only. Take a baseline frame of a window (target, must be in the foreground) or a whole display (display), optionally after settle_ms, then compare a fresh frame every 100 ms until the share of changed pixels reaches threshold. A pixel changed when any channel differs by more than tolerance. Supply exactly one of target or display; region (image-relative x, y, width, height) limits the comparison. Never sends input and does not consume or create a capture proof. A timeout is NOT an error: it returns changed=false with the largest ratio seen. Cancellable. Use it instead of fixed sleeps after a click or keystroke.

target.description: Window target from windows_list or window_wait. Supply exactly one of target or display.

display.description: Display reference from displays_list. Supply exactly one of target or display.

region.description: Optional crop in image-relative pixels (origin at the captured window or display top-left).

threshold.description: Fraction of changed pixels that counts as a change. At least one pixel must change.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a change.

settle_ms.description: Wait this long before taking the baseline, e.g. to skip an animation you triggered.

changed.description: True when the change ratio reached the threshold; false on timeout.

ratio.description: Changed-pixel share that triggered the result, or the largest seen on timeout.

bounds.description: Bounding box {left, top, width, height} of changed pixels in image coordinates; null on timeout.

elapsed_ms.description: Time spent comparing, excluding settle_ms and the baseline capture.

name: run
title: Run Steps
description: Run 1 to 8 tool calls in order in one request, each through the normal tool path (capture proofs, corner fail-safe, emergency stop and cancellation all still apply), waiting settle_ms between steps. Stops at the first failed step. The batch itself succeeds even when a step failed: read completed, stopped_at and the per-step error. Use "$last" as a step's capture_id to refer to the newest capture taken inside this batch. run, app_launch and screensaver cannot be used as steps. Intermediate images are dropped; with image=last the final step's image is returned. Prefer short batches that end in a capture so the result can be verified.

steps.description: Tool calls to run in order.

tool.description: Tool name, e.g. capture, click_at, type_text, hotkey, wait_change.

arguments.description: Arguments exactly as for the tool called on its own.

image.description: none drops all step images; last keeps the final step's image.

stopped_at.description: Index of the first failed step, or null when all succeeded.

result.description: The step's structured result when ok.

error.description: Structured tool error when not ok.
